caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high back consisting of four horizontal, wavy slats held between two vertical posts that are topped with finial-like shapes. The chair’s armrests are curved and extend outward before connecting to vertical supports that connect to the seat. The seat of the chair is rectangular and appears lighter in color, suggesting either a different material or an unfinished area in the drawing. The front legs of the chair are lathe-turned, with bulbous ornamentation near the seat and more slender, tapering sections toward the feet. A similar lathe-turned stretcher bar connects the two front legs, featuring symmetrical, rounded details in the center. More stretcher bars connect to the rear legs, which are barely visible. The coloring is primarily in shades of brown, suggesting a wood finish, while the seat area and some elements are left in light beige, indicating incomplete coloring or different textures. The lines and shapes of the chair are precisely defined, with faint pencil sketches showing construction lines and outlines in the background, as well as partial, unfinished sketches of small additional chair parts and outlines in gray pencil to the left and right of the completed chair image. The drawing is centered on a plain off-white or beige background.
title: Chair
